en.title: The Best Subsequence | Minimize Special Value
en.description:
Choose k elements, keeping their original order, so that the sum of the absolute differences between adjacent chosen values is minimized.

This site's standard input/output format and supplementary bounds are as described in this problem.
en.input: The first line contains n k (1≤n≤800, 1≤k≤n); the next line contains n integers, |arr[i]|≤10^9.
en.explanation: Do dynamic programming over the subsequence length. The transition is `min_j(dp[j]+|a[i]-a[j]|)`; split it into a prefix minimum of `dp[j]-a[j]` and a suffix minimum of `dp[j]+a[j]` over values in sorted order, and update them with a scan. Exhaustive enumeration of combinations provides an independent check.
